notes.title: Director Letter #1
notes.content:
Hello everybody! This is Niizato, the director of Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3.
Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3 will finally be releasing on May 29th, and in anticipation of that there are a few things I wanted to share.

[h3][b]Please, please play Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 and Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 first if you can![/b][/h3]
While we took the greatest care to make sure that Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3 could be enjoyed without having to play the previous games, it is the finale in the series, and [u][b]we're sure you will enjoy Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3 even more if you know about the characters as they appeared in previous titles, or about the story that is coming to a conclusion in this latest chapter![/b][/u]

[h3][b]Clear the game in a breeze with Fast Mode![/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=4j83XTrLFxc;full][/previewyoutube]
The new update brings Fast Mode to Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 and 2. Put very simply, [u][b]Fast Mode makes you invincible during battles.[/b][/u] The Soul Cannon of the Fuga series forces you to sacrifice a child to defeat an enemy, but Fast Mode has no demerits whatsoever, allowing you to quickly cut through your foes. What's more, [u][b]you can even use Fast Mode in the middle of your normal playthrough as a separate save data.[/b][/u]

This means that once you've played through to the end and had your fill of the story with Fast Mode, you can go back to your original save point and enjoy the game again, this time with the battles in place. But of course, how you choose to enjoy the game is entirely up to you! Please treat it simply as an option that exists for your benefit.

You can choose to enter Fast Mode from the very start of Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3, but as someone who has worked on the game I can't personally recommend doing so. My suggestion is that you first play through the newly powered-up battle system, and if you need to, you can always change to Fast Mode halfway through!

notes.title: Announcing Patch 1.50 Update for Fuga: Melodies of Steel
notes.content:
■Patch Notes (Version 1.50)
・Turbo Mode/Auto Text status can now be saved. 
・Improved visibility when enabling/disabling Turbo Mode/Auto Text.
・Turbo Mode is now available to players starting from their first playthrough—and its speed has been doubled.
・Retry Mode has been added to help players who missed the true ending.
・Corrected the colors of HP/SP waypoints to match the color of the gauges.
・Changed default key assignments of confirm/cancel for keyboard control.
・Added a feature to check the status of the Taranis from the item trade screen.
・Increased the battle tempo.
・The newly added binoculars lets you check the enemy's status right from the formation screen.
・Improved usability of the formation screen.
・Improved visual effect in the battle result screen.
・Cross-key control is now supported during intermissions.
・Improved usability of character change UI for intermissions.
・Improved visual effect of unlocking facilities.
・Added the automatic harvesting of crops before each intermission.
・Improved usability of Farming UI.
・Improved usability of Dormitory UI.
・Improved usability of Laundry Room UI.
・Improved usability of Observation Room/Expedition UI.
・Default page of the status screen is changed to a character in control.
・Improved visibility of the item trade menu.
・Other improvements include: Operational stability and bug fixes

We hope this helps improve your Fuga: Melodies of Steel gameplay experience.
